description: This file defines React components and context for a toast notification system, including a provider, hook, and toast item component.

methods.name: ToastProvider
methods.description: React component that manages a list of toast notifications and renders them in a fixed position container.

methods.name: useToast
methods.description: Custom hook that provides access to toast notification functions within the context.

methods.name: ToastItem
methods.description: React component that renders an individual toast notification with styling based on its type.
